title: Implement a singly linked list in TypeScript
description: Implement a generic-free singly linked list in TypeScript/Node.js with push, pop, peek, size, and toArray. All methods throw 'not implemented'.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the LinkedList methods in linked_list.js:

1. push(value): Append a new Node to the tail. Update this._size.
2. pop(): Walk to the second-to-last node, detach last, decrement this._size, return the value. Throw Error('empty') if size is 0.
3. peek(): Walk to the last node and return its value. Throw Error('empty') if size is 0.
4. size(): Return this._size.
5. toArray(): Walk from this.head, collecting values into an array. Return []  if empty.

Run `node test_linked_list.js` to verify (should print 'All tests passed!').
success_criteria: node test_linked_list.js exits 0 and prints 'All tests passed!'
pop removes from tail and returns value
followup_prompts: Run `node test_linked_list.js` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `node test_linked_list.js` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
